purpose: В public browser ограничить новые поиски после пяти подряд завершённых no_matches через отдельную cookie.
success_outcome: После пятого подряд completed no_matches сразу показана точная пауза AC-014; browser cookie хранит счётчик и deadline через reload/смену площадок, новый поиск заблокирован на 30 минут; success/expiry очищают счётчик, прочие outcomes его не расходуют.
anti_goals: Не реализовывать экран/кнопку AC-012 или менять существующие заказы, order refresh, оплату, server admission и all-date scope.

stop_conditions: Stop on a newly required public/shared contract, owner change, production action or higher tier; route through owning workflow.

constraints: Planning Revision 4; direct accepted AC-014 only; no new server cooldown, storage table, migration, device fingerprint, package dependency or production task.
touched_files is advisory; existing historical task identities/status/evidence remain unchanged.
Primary owner is the public browser in client/; typed no_matches/result crosses the existing Public Search API. Server admission/profile cookie remain promo-owned.

Tests and RED/GREEN prove only AC-014; AC-012 screen proof remains with TASK-148. The combined journey is checked after both outcomes are implemented.
verification_targets: FT-013-AC-014: existing Playwright HTTPS/browser fixture with isolated context/cookie jar and controlled browser time: real completed no_matches 1–5 across reload and venue change, four available retries, exact fifth copy/spacing, no new POST until fifth outcome +30 min, expiry and success reset. Browser network stubs show the guard applies only to new search POST, leaving existing result/order refresh and payment actions reachable without initiating a real payment. Fresh context and cleanup make rerun safe; AC-012 exact screen/return is independently proved by TASK-148 and both form the feature-level full journey.
